import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
# Robust SE and nonlinearity checks for carbon_pct and porosity
for c in ['carbon_pct','porosity']:
    m = smf.ols(f'tensile_mpa ~ {c} + C(lab)', data=df).fit(cov_type='HC3')
    print(f"{c}: coef={m.params[c]:.4f} p(HC3)={m.pvalues[c]:.4f}")
    # add quadratic
    m2 = smf.ols(f'tensile_mpa ~ {c} + I({c}**2) + C(lab)', data=df).fit()
    print(f"   quad term p={m2.pvalues[f'I({c} ** 2)']:.4f}")
print()
# binned means within lab (residualize on lab first)
for c in ['carbon_pct','porosity']:
    d = df.dropna(subset=['tensile_mpa']).copy()
    d['resid'] = smf.ols('tensile_mpa ~ C(lab)', data=d).fit().resid
    d['bin'] = pd.qcut(d[c], 5)
    print(c)
    print(d.groupby('bin', observed=True)['resid'].mean().round(2).to_string())
    print()

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
d = df.dropna(subset=['tensile_mpa']).copy()

# Robust regression (Huber) for each candidate with lab
for c in ['carbon_pct','porosity']:
    X = pd.get_dummies(d[['lab']], drop_first=True).astype(float)
    X[c] = d[c].values
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    rlm = sm.RLM(d['tensile_mpa'], X, M=sm.robust.norms.HuberT()).fit()
    print(f"{c}: RLM coef={rlm.params[c]:.4f} p={rlm.pvalues[c]:.4f}")

print()
# Influence: drop top-5 leverage points
for c in ['carbon_pct','porosity']:
    m = smf.ols(f'tensile_mpa ~ {c} + C(lab)', data=d).fit()
    infl = m.get_influence()
    cooks = infl.cooks_distance[0]
    keep = cooks < np.percentile(cooks, 95)
    m2 = smf.ols(f'tensile_mpa ~ {c} + C(lab)', data=d[keep]).fit()
    print(f"{c}: full p={m.pvalues[c]:.4f}, drop top5% cooks p={m2.pvalues[c]:.4f} coef={m2.params[c]:.4f}")

    dd = d[d[c] < thr]
    m = smf.ols(f'tensile_mpa ~ {c} + C(lab)', data=dd).fit()
    print(f"{c}: drop top10% -> coef={m.params[c]:.4f} p={m.pvalues[c]:.4f}")
    thr2 = d[c].quantile(0.1)
    dd2 = d[d[c] > thr2]
    m2 = smf.ols(f'tensile_mpa ~ {c} + C(lab)', data=dd2).fit()

df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')

    # add quadratic
    m2 = smf.ols(f'tensile_mpa ~ {c} + I({c}**2) + C(lab)', data=df).fit()

print()
# binned means within lab (residualize on lab first)
for c in ['carbon_pct','porosity']:
    d = df.dropna(subset=['tensile_mpa']).copy()
    d['resid'] = smf.ols('tensile_mpa ~ C(lab)', data=d).fit().resid
    d['bin'] = pd.qcut(d[c], 5)
    print(c)
    print(d.groupby('bin', observed=True)['resid'].mean().round(2).to_string())
    print()
"}

{"code": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
d = df.dropna(subset=['tensile_mpa']).copy()

# Robust regression (Huber) for each candidate with lab
for c in ['carbon_pct','porosity']:
    X = pd.get_dummies(d[['lab']], drop_first=True).astype(float)
    X[c] = d[c].values
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    rlm = sm.RLM(d['tensile_mpa'], X, M=sm.robust.norms.HuberT()).fit()
    print(f"{c}: RLM coef={rlm.params[c]:.4f} p={rlm.pvalues[c]:.4f}")

print()
# Influence: drop top-5 leverage points
for c in ['carbon_pct','porosity']:
    m = smf.ols(f'tensile_mpa ~ {c} + C(lab)', data=d).fit()
    infl = m.get_influence()
    cooks = infl.cooks_distance[0]
    keep = cooks < np.percentile(cooks, 95)
    m2 = smf.ols(f'tensile_mpa ~ {c} + C(lab)', data=d[keep]).fit()
    print(f"{c}: full p={m.pvalues[c]:.4f}, drop top5% cooks p={m2.pvalues[c]:.4f} coef={m2.params[c]:.4f}")
"}
